conditional_second_wave.selection_rule: Select at most one additional checkpoint after recording official code and weight availability, same-arena adapter feasibility, action-interface compatibility, scientific non-redundancy, and time-to-six-valid-cells. Freeze a model-specific registry in a new disclosed amendment before inference.
conditional_second_wave.zero_policy: Unavailable or technically incompatible candidates remain not measured, never zero.

unchanged_rules: Never pool DROID and RoboTwin raw success rates.
Use static episode prompts with no oracle, subtask coach, prompt switching, or progress-conditioned language.
Preserve every valid failure and keep infrastructure failures outside model denominators.
Record simulator video for every new behavioral episode.
Keep raw outputs, checkpoints, and environments on ali-owned PVC storage outside ordinary Git.
Score generated futures only when the released interface exposes decodable future evidence.
Do not rewrite the original frozen protocol or known-result disclosures.
claim_boundary: V2-A005 is a disclosed post-result expansion. It authorizes bounded new evidence after the completed three-WAM results were known; it does not retroactively preregister the added experiments or change any completed result.
